jp: 静馬さん
en: Shizuma-san.

jp: ？　なんだ
en: ? What is it?

jp: 母を知りませんか？
en: Have you seen my mother?

jp: 無線でも、\n連絡がつかなくて
en: I can't reach her on the radio either.

jp: さぁな、少なくとも、\nここには来ていない
en: Who knows. She hasn't come here, at least.

jp: 麟、譲葉の名を継ぐ\n決心はついたか？
en: Rin, have you made up your mind to inherit the Yuzuriha name?

jp: ……いえ、まだ
en: ...No, not yet.

jp: 僕は、\nまだ、この歳ですし、
en: I'm still only this age,

jp: ゆっくり、\n母さんと話そうと\n思っています
en: so I plan to take my time and talk it over with Mother.

jp: 譲葉の名を継ぐ？
en: Inherit the Yuzuriha name?

jp: ふみゅ\nお家相続？
en: Fumyu. Family succession?

jp: 譲葉の名？継ぐ？
en: The Yuzuriha name? Inherit?

jp: そう言ってたね
en: That's what he said.

jp: あぁ、名を継ぐ\nと言ってたね
en: Yes, he said "inherit the name."

jp: 麟に、譲葉の頭首と\nなる話がでてるん\nだろうね
en: There must be talk of Rin becoming head of the Yuzuriha.

jp: あんなに、若いのに？
en: Even though he's so young?

jp: ふみゅ。\nそれだけ、優れた\n言の葉ということ？
en: Fumyu. Meaning his words are that exceptional?

jp: ふーん、あの年で\n頭首になるの？
en: Huh, he'd become head at that age?

jp: 能力が、現頭首より\n優れていれば、\nあまり歳は関係ないよ
en: If his ability surpasses the current head's, age doesn't matter much.

jp: そうだね、現頭首より\n優れたものが、\n現れた場合は
en: That's right -- if someone more gifted than the current head turns up.

jp: それだけ、麟に譲葉と\nしての能力があるって\nことだろうね
en: It must mean Rin has that much ability as a Yuzuriha.

jp: 嫡子じゃなくても\nすぐに相続すると\n聞いたこともあるしね
en: I've heard it passes on right away, even to someone who isn't the heir by birth.

jp: 【譲葉の名を継ぐ】\nの刻音を手に入れた！
en: Obtained the [Inheriting the Yuzuriha Name] Echo!
